title: Daily Dispatch presentation table
description: Every word the end-turn sequence and the Daily Dispatch put on screen. The engine emits content-free beat records (ids and numbers); this table turns a beat kind into prose, a chapter, a tone and a severity. Beat ids must match TurnJournal.KINDS exactly in both directions.

chapters.description: The day's acts, in the order they are played and printed.

visibility.description: own: only the faction it happened to. region: only if the region is in the viewer's fog-of-war set. own_or_region: either. public: heralds carry it everywhere.

severity.description: 1 is a ledger line, 5 stops the room. Drives headline picking and which beats survive the sequence cap.

in_sequence.description: Played as a beat during the day's sequence

in_dispatch.description: Printed in the Daily Dispatch recap
